_rule: THE ONE PLACE the [I] numbers of jarvis.py, legs.py and mstate.py live (thresholds.py, Jarvis v3 Task 6). Every change needs a NOTEPAD line (docs/live/NOTEPAD.md) with its reason, before the change; the registered rules (research-findings.md §1b-§1r) are never moved here. Re-read at the next build, no restart. A value here equal to the module's own is no change; delete a key to go back to the module's default.

_why.jarvis.P5_MIN: the |p5| floor of the fut-OI run's direction stamp per index (spec §14 row 8); an index not named reads BANKNIFTY's
_why.jarvis.FAST: SPEED FAST: |3-min delta| >= 2x its own median so far
_why.jarvis.SLOW: SPEED SLOW: |3-min delta| <= 0.5x its own median so far
_why.jarvis.SYNC_PTS: ALL 3 in sync: NIFTY fut / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX moved 10 / 25 / 35 pts the same way in 5 min
_why.jarvis.WF_L: WRITER FLOW ±7: a leg is 10L in 3 min on a side (legs.py's (lagging) note reads this same key)
_why.jarvis.WF_STOP: WRITER FLOW ±7: the covering side has stopped at >= -2L in 3 min
_why.jarvis.RISK_X: TOP / BOTTOM RISK: a 3-min delta >= 2x its day median against the ±7 leg
_why.jarvis.RISK_WIN: TOP / BOTTOM RISK: within 9 min of the ±7 pause
_why.jarvis.RISK_CONF: G2: ... unless price went 0.3 of a strike step against the leg since
_why.jarvis.BLIND_MIN: P0: the newest minute more than 2 min behind the clock is BLIND (CAN'T SEE)
_why.jarvis.LAD_NEAR: each minute's ladder also holds ATM ±7 of that minute (the ±7 writer flow's width), so a read never changes with later minutes
_why.jarvis.FIGHT_AWAY: P2: a fight's wall more than 2 strike steps from price ...
_why.jarvis.FIGHT_AWAY_MIN: P2: ... for 15 min is left behind (PEECHHE CHHOOTA)
_why.jarvis.MANAGE_PTS: MANAGE: AGAINST YOU at <= -15 pts, HOLD / BOOK at >= +15 pts (judged against price first, GAPS §1)
_why.jarvis.MANAGE_WIN: MANAGE and the count's setup piece: a zone trigger's 45-min window (46 = through its 45th minute)
_why.jarvis.MANAGE_GAP: MANAGE: a changed word at least 6 min after the last
_why.jarvis.QUIET_MIN: NO TRADE quiet: 20 minutes with no break, no fuel, no trigger, writers not pushing
_why.jarvis.ACT_LEAD: the ACTION word: TREND needs WITH >= AGAINST + 2 (the 0/11 red-leg buys vs the 6/10 holds)
_why.jarvis.ACT_CLOSES: the ACTION word: a new word needs the same candidate at 2 consecutive 3-min closes (78 / 52 / 79 raw flips on 21 / 29 / 30 Oct)
_why.jarvis.ANSWER_MIN: the count's last answer: a push answered within 15 min (the band verdict's DASTAK window)
_why.jarvis.AHEAD_STEPS: the count's wall ahead: within 2 strike steps of spot (the band verdict's own reach)
_why.jarvis.BOX_STEPS: the range guard (A229): a lean flip is RANGE when the leg turned inside the writers' box, its extreme within 1 strike step of a wall (a poke past a wall that came back is still the box)
_why.jarvis.NEED_X: the buyer's required move = the ATM premium x 1.15 in points (algo_ai T3: the premium back plus spread and theta)
_why.jarvis.IV_RV: ATM IV >= RV x 1.15 reads rich, <= RV / 1.15 cheap, else fair (the seller's edge)
_why.jarvis.CPR_NARROW: CPR narrow when |tc - bc| <= 0.1 x the prior day's range
_why.jarvis.POOL_X: the stop's pool: PDH / PWH (a short; a long PDL / PWL) beyond the stop within 1.5x its distance
_why.jarvis.UNWIND_AT: 0 DTE from 14:00: writers covering is the expiry unwind (G9), never counted WITH
_why.jarvis.RANK_3OF5: rank_build keeps |5-min delta| medians; a 3-min sum's yardstick is sqrt(3/5) of one (the bigger of sqrt and linear: fewer FAST)
_why.jarvis.RV_CAL: RV (252 trading days) onto the chain IV's 365 calendar days: sqrt(365/252), scaled by sqrt(trading / calendar days to expiry) when the expiry is known
_why.jarvis.VIX_OPEN_BY: the day's first India VIX row by 09:17 is its open (09:15's candle, or one or two missing from Upstox); later reads since HH:MM (started late)
_why.legs.LEG_MIN: a leg: 40 pts origin -> extreme (~0.2 of a percent; under it is tick noise)
_why.legs.LEG_MIN_U: the day's first leg also needs 2U (U = max(sigma, 0.1 of a percent of price)): 30 Oct flipped the lean 7x in 38 min
_why.legs.TREND_PTS: after 10:00 a trend leg is >= 80 pts (~2U on a quiet day)
_why.legs.TREND_Z: ... that reached 1.5 sigma of the session VWAP (23/35 vs 6/19), or had a TOOT, or was fuelled
_why.legs.OPEN_PTS: before 10:00 only >= 100 pts with a TOOT counts (10/35 vs 2/30); sigma means nothing yet
_why.legs.PAUSE_U: a pause: 0.25U back from the extreme (the stack's break distance, HOLD v2 / marks TOOTA)
_why.legs.PAUSE_MIN: or no new extreme for 6 min (two of her 3-min bars)
_why.legs.NEW_U: a real new extreme: 0.25U past the pause's extreme (a 3-pt new low is not running)
_why.legs.REV_FRAC: PALAT: half the leg given back ...
_why.legs.SHALLOW: shallow pullback: < 0.20 of the leg after SHALLOW_MIN (21/31 vs 5/17 one bar in)
_why.legs.SHALLOW_MIN: one 3-min bar into the pause before shallow means anything
_why.legs.DEEP: PALAT?: 0.35 of the leg given back (0/31 vs 6/17 one bar in)
_why.legs.K1_L: k1 loading / emptying: 2L in 9 min (the handshake's CUT_L floor); loading 14/34 vs 2/19
_why.legs.BAND_L: k1..k3 emptying: 4L in 9 min (7/10 vs 6/23 one bar in, 27 Oct out)
_why.legs.D3_AGAINST: 3-min delta against >= 150 lots (the push floor MIN_PUSH)
_why.legs.FAST: speed FAST at a pause: |3-min delta| >= 2x its own median so far. ONE number with jarvis.FAST under two keys: change both together
_why.legs.PREM_RS: ATM premium vs delta: 0.5 Rs (10 ticks) beyond what delta explains; holding 10/27 vs 2/16
_why.legs.COIL: coiling: the pause's range <= 0.5x the 9 min before the extreme (21/35 vs 7/19)
_why.legs.Z_INSIDE: back inside 1 sigma after a >= TREND_Z leg: the band is the trend's home
_why.legs.MARK_LAG: a footprint mark is known at its bar's close + 1 min (ofd_marks2 has no first-seen stamp)
_why.legs.MARK_NEAR_U: a mark counts within 1U of the leg's extreme
_why.legs.MARK_LATE_MIN: a mark first appended after a row whose bar is >= 10 min later was revised late
_why.legs.MARK_FRESH_MIN: a mark is a risk item for 15 min after it became known, then an old note (29 Oct: one mark kept PALAT? on for 3 hours)
_why.legs.PREM_FRESH: the premium read is anchored at the leg's extreme for 15 min, then at the minute 15 min ago (theta over a long pause is not bleeding)
_why.legs.Z_RETRACE_MIN: inside 1 sigma counts only when price came back >= 0.20 of the leg, not when VWAP walked up. ONE number with legs.SHALLOW under two keys: change both together
_why.legs.WATCH_N: WATCH at >= 2 risk items (12/19 reversals, 9/35 continuations)
_why.legs.PALAT_N: PALAT? at >= 3 risk items (0/31 vs 6/17 one bar in)
_why.legs.CONFIRM_MIN: PALAT? confirmed after 6 min of its condition, or at a 3-min close
_why.legs.MIN_SHOW: a confirmed PALAT? stays on screen 6 min (flicker halved on 8 of 9 days)
_why.legs.HOLD_MIN: WATCH -> HOLD waits one 3-min bar; HOLD -> WATCH / PALAT? shows at once
_why.legs.PUSH_WIN: a push with the leg in the last 10 min (23/35 vs 9/19); also the wall-behind-broke window
_why.legs.FUT_WIN: the slow fut-OI quadrant: over 30 min ...
_why.legs.HORIZON: the after-the-fact outcome window of the forward log, 45 min
_why.mstate.EFF_WIN: the state's efficiency: |net move| / path of the 1-min closes over the last 45 min (spec 2026-11-06 §3, A256)
_why.mstate.EFF_RANGE: an unconfirmed TREND leg reads RANGE below efficiency 0.3 ...
_why.mstate.VWAP_X: ... with >= 2 VWAP returns in those 45 min
_why.mstate.NORM_N: the bar-range yardstick: the same 3-min slot's median high-low over the last 10 futures sessions (data/backtest)
_why.mstate.NORM_MIN: ... read only with >= 5 sessions on the record; fewer: could not check
_why.mstate.RANGE_HI: a 3-min bar >= 1.5x its slot's median votes EXPANDING
_why.mstate.RANGE_LO: a 3-min bar <= 0.67x its slot's median votes CONTRACTING
_why.mstate.GAUGE_WIN: the straddle / VIX / ATM IV gauges read their change over 15 min
_why.mstate.VIX_PTS: India VIX +/- 0.3 in 15 min votes EXPANDING / CONTRACTING
_why.mstate.IV_PTS: ATM IV +/- 0.5 vol points in 15 min votes EXPANDING / CONTRACTING
_why.mstate.VOL_N: EXPANDING / CONTRACTING needs 2 gauges that way, more than the other way
